    The 6-stage process

    How studying abroad actually works

    From shortlisting universities to enroling on day one — here's what to expect at each stage.

    1. 01

      Research

      Shortlist destinations, universities and programmes using verified entry requirements and tuition ranges.

    2. 02

      Shortlist

      Narrow to 5–8 universities across safe / match / ambitious tiers. Save and compare them on Alaminn.info.

    3. 03

      Apply

      Prepare SOP, CV, references and transcripts. Apply directly or via ALO Education with consent-tracked referral.

    4. 04

      Offer

      Receive conditional or unconditional offers. Compare scholarship offers and accept your best fit.

    5. 05

      Visa

      Apply for your student visa with CAS/COE, financial evidence and biometrics. Book early — slots fill up.

    6. 06

      Enrol

      Pre-departure briefing, accommodation confirmation, travel and enrolment on day one. Welcome abroad.

    FAQ

    Higher Study, answered

    Is the Higher Study information on Alaminn.info free?+

    Yes. All verified university, course, scholarship, PhD and supervisor information is free to browse. When you choose to apply, you are transferred to ALO Education, Alaminn.info's official application partner, with full consent tracking.

    How is the information verified?+

    Every entity has a verification status (draft, pending-review, verified, published, needs-update or archived) and a last-verified timestamp. Where possible, we link to the official source so you can confirm details directly with the university or funding body.

    What does applying through ALO Education mean?+

    When you click Apply, we create a referral record with only public context (study level, country, programme slug) and transfer you to ALO Education's secure registration page. Your name, email and documents are collected by ALO Education after the transfer, on their own domain.

    Can I save universities and courses for later?+

    Yes. Use the Save button on any card to bookmark it. Anonymous saves are stored in your browser; if you sign in, they sync to your Alaminn.info account. You can also compare up to 4 entities side-by-side.

    Do you cover scholarships for international students?+

    Yes — we track 24 funding types including fully-funded, government, university, research-council and named programmes like Chevening, Commonwealth, Erasmus Mundus, Rhodes, Gates Cambridge, Marshall, Fulbright and DAAD.

    How often is the data updated?+

    Verification timestamps are shown on every entity. We sweep stale records and mark them as 'needs-update' when they pass their review cycle. You can subscribe to the bi-weekly digest for new scholarship and PhD deadlines.

    Application partner

    Trust & verification

    Every record has an evidence chain

    We don't publish unverified metrics. Every entity carries a verification status, a last-verified timestamp, and (where possible) a link to the official source.

    Verification lifecycle

    Each entity moves through draft → pending-review → verified → published. Stale records are flagged 'needs-update' and re-reviewed before they're republished.

    Source-of-truth links

    Where the university or funding body publishes the data themselves, we link to their page directly — so you can confirm details at the source.

    Last-verified timestamps

    Every card shows when the record was last verified. Records older than their review cycle are marked visually before you act on them.

    Privacy & consent

    How your data is handled

    Alaminn.info collects only the data needed to operate the Higher Study platform. Anonymous browsing — looking at universities, courses and scholarships — is fully anonymous: we use privacy-friendly, cookie-less analytics that respect Do Not Track.

    When you save an item, build a comparison, or subscribe to a deadline alert, that data is stored either in your browser (anonymous) or in your account (when signed in). When you click Apply, a referral record is created with only public context (study level, country, programme slug), signed with a 24-hour token, and the destination URL never contains your name, email, phone or any other PII.

    ALO Education collects your personal information on their own secure domain after the transfer, under their own privacy policy. Read our full privacy policy and terms of service.

    Stay informed

    Get deadline alerts & new opportunity digests

    Bi-weekly digest of verified scholarships, PhD projects and upcoming intakes. No spam — unsubscribe anytime.

    Technical University of Munich

    MSc in Informatics

    “Tuition-free master's at TUM with DAAD funding — the application process, blocked account, and learning German basics.”

    Advice: Apply via Uni-assist early. Block your Sperrkonto at least 3 months before visa interview. Learn German — even A1 helps.
    United States

    Rifat Hasan

    MIT

    MSc in EECS

    “Self-taught ML researcher to MIT RA-supported master's — what I learned about publications, recommendations, and luck.”

    Advice: Demonstrate research capability, not just grades. Submit to workshops. Your recommender's letter matters more than your GRE.
    United Kingdom

    Anika Rahman

    University of Oxford

    DPhil in Computer Science

    “From a small town in Bangladesh to a Clarendon Fund scholarship at Oxford — my journey through 18 months of structured preparation.”

    Advice: Start your SOP 6 months before the deadline. Connect with current students on LinkedIn. Apply to 3-5 supervisors, not 30.
